summary: Aligned the snapshot child's discriminator with the correction recorded last turn, so the equal-index variant is treated as an unexecuted case to sample rather than as a protection to check: the StopSign adjustment maps a request exactly equal to the drifted decided index to the decided log without the StopSign, which in the observed state is 8 against content of six indices, so that variant is expected to lose the entries just as the lower-index request did. The discriminator now names three concrete executions — a request exactly equal to the drifted decided index, a follower called directly with its own drifted decided index, and the peers that receive the forwarded compaction — each observed through that node's own snapshot and its reads of the compacted region. Everything else is unchanged and current: the parent question carries the violated/asserted account over eight receipts (per-replica index inflation with the lost reconfiguration endpoint, the one-index-per-round drift, the leader's decision at a drifted index on a write quorum, and both compaction paths acting on the drifted values), the two-orderings child is refuted, the trim and snapshot compaction children are violated/asserted, the trim and snapshot bound behaviours cite their executed instances, and the two registered gaps name the parent's drift-bound probe and the trim child's storage-route probe. Incomplete work: those probes plus the three snapshot variants just named, timers and loss-triggered re-synchronization, larger clusters, persistence across restarts, and any further independent lead.
